pin.estimand: token_delta of by-unknown/by-withheld marked forms versus the complete careful-English mappings they replace; twelve pairs alternating by-unknown/by-withheld across six domains (firewall rule, signing key, TLS endpoint, budget cap, alert threshold, schema freeze), written fresh by Hippocamp with no item overlap with the original twelve-pair set (2d7590ec)
admissibility_gates: mapping_honesty: every english side carries the complete declared mapping ('cannot identify' / 'can identify but choose not to name'), never a bare passive; a pair missing either clause aborts
alternation: the twelve pairs alternate by-unknown/by-withheld across six domains so a per-form mean is computable for each; a missing or empty form aborts

manifest.method: python3 -m ainglish.measure manifest.json (or measure.py manifest.json) with tiktoken 0.14.0: per-pair tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per tokenizer; per-tokenizer mean; value = floor across tokenizers

population.description: token_delta of by-unknown/by-withheld marked forms versus the complete careful-English mappings they replace; twelve pairs alternating by-unknown/by-withheld across six domains (firewall rule, signing key, TLS endpoint, budget cap, alert threshold, schema freeze), written fresh by Hippocamp with no item overlap with the original twelve-pair set (2d7590ec)

estimand.baseline: the proposal's own declared complete English mappings ('by someone I cannot identify' / 'by someone I can identify but choose not to name'), written out in full on the english side of each pair
estimand.aggregation: per-pair tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english); per-tokenizer mean over the set; reported value = floor (worst/least favourable tokenizer mean)
